desc:
🌱 TRAIN. THROW. GROW THE RAREST PLANTS! 🌱

💪 Do pull-ups to gain Strength!
🎯 Hit the PERFECT throw to launch your seed further!
🌍 Throw your seed into new zones to grow better plants!
🌻 Watch your plant burst out of the ground in EPIC reveals!
🔥 Find GOLD, DIAMOND, CANDY, FIRE & RADIOACTIVE mutations!
🌳 Grow BIG, HUGE & TITANIC plants for massive cash!
💰 Place plants in your base to earn cash every second!
⬆️ Upgrade your pull-up bar, your base & your seeds!

🏆 Complete each Zone's Index, discover MYTHIC & DIVINE plants and reach the FINAL ZONE!
